scenes.name: QUESTION
lines: Why do two continuous parity-odd readings fail on chiral events?
为什么两个连续的宇称奇读数会在手性事件上失效？
The answer is a sphere, an antipodal symmetry, and three variables.
答案是一张球面、一个对跖对称，以及三个变量。

scenes.name: SPHERE
lines: Let s, t, and d run over the unit sphere.
让 s、t、d 在单位球面上运动。
The sphere becomes four momenta, with square roots of four plus t and four minus t.
球面变成四个动量，横向长度是四加 t 和四减 t 的平方根。
Every point is a strict future-timelike collision event.
每一点都是严格未来类时的碰撞事件。

scenes.name: CHIRALITY
lines: The unequal squared masses of p and q forbid exchanging the first pair.
p 和 q 的平方质量不同，所以第一对不能交换。
Fixing or exchanging the second pair then contradicts the determinant or the unit-sphere equation.
固定或交换第二对，都会与行列式条件或单位球面方程矛盾。
So the entire sphere is chiral.
因此整张球面都是手性的。

scenes.name: ANTIPODE
lines: A proper rotation and the permitted exchange send parity to the antipodal point.
一个保持定向的旋转和允许的交换把宇称像送到对跖点。
Every admissible reading therefore changes sign at opposite points.
所以每个可容许读数在相对点变号。
Two readings form a continuous odd map from the sphere to the plane.
两个读数组成从球面到平面的连续奇映射。

scenes.name: BORSUK
lines: Borsuk–Ulam forces that odd map to hit zero.
Borsuk–Ulam 定理迫使这个奇映射取到零。
The zero is a chiral event where both readings vanish.
这个零点就是两个读数同时消失的手性事件。
Thus any sufficient continuous family needs at least three variables.
因此任何充分的连续变量族至少需要三个变量。

scenes.name: SCOPE
lines: The Lean proof covers this lower bound on both event domains.
Lean 证明覆盖两个事件域上的这个下界。
The exact minimum three also uses the sufficient triples from the original paper.
精确最小三还要使用原论文给出的充分三元组。
